governing_invariant: Model memory is never authoritative. Current epistemic state must be reconstructible from immutable source-linked events.
hard_rules: No downstream state may be silently inferred from an upstream state.
Institutional acceptance is not evidentiary weight.
A previously prosecuted objection reopens only with new evidence, contradiction, methodological flaw, failed prediction, or a materially changed upstream state.
Corrections supersede; they do not erase lineage.
Conventional scholarship, institutions, Geonosis, users and AI carry the same derivational burden at the same claim scope.
Do not infer intent from provenance failure without an evidence chain supporting intent.
No presumptive institutional excuse: claimed access, custody, cataloguing, loss or rights limitations require their own evidence and do not automatically mitigate high-demand provenance failure.
research_duty: An unresolved reversal condition is an actionable research target. OGI should attempt to advance it rather than merely restate it.
